answer.explanation: Average contribution this round is below 30% of the endowment, so conditional cooperation requires boosting contribution; we contribute the full wallet. We also praise Resident3 for their high contribution.

message.reasoning: We need decide for round 9. Wallet 7.91, below 30% of initial (30). So conserve: contribute 30% of wallet = 0.3*7.91=2.373. Round 9 average contribution? compute total contributions round9: sum contributions_by_agent = Resident1 1 +2? Actually values: Resident1 1.0, Resident2 1.0, Resident3 5.62, Resident4 1.0, Resident5 1.69, Resident6 5.62 = total 16.93. Average per agent = 16.93/6=2.822 >30% of endowment (30). So average >30 but <45? 2.822 is 2.8% of endowment, but rule uses percentage of endowment? The constitution says average contribution below 30% of endowment triggers boost, above 45% revert baseline. Here average is 2.8% which is below 30%, so we should boost contribution by extra 30% of wallet (i.e., contribute full wallet?). But we are low wallet, but rule says "increase contribution by extra 30% of your wallet to push group back up". That means contribution = baseline 80% + extra 30% = 110% of wallet but cannot exceed wallet. So we can contribute full wallet 7.91. However conserve rule says if wallet below 30% of initial, reduce contribution to 30% of wallet to preserve funds. Conflict: need prioritize? Constitution order: first Contribute Generously, then Conditional Cooperation, then Punish, then Communicate, then Praise, then Conserve Resources. So Conserve is later, so earlier rules have priority. So we must follow conditional cooperation: average <30% => increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet (i.e., contribute full wallet). So action: contribute amount 7.91 (or maybe 7.91). Also we can send private message praising high contributors (>=60% of wallet). Our wallet 7.91, 60% is 4.746. Who contributed >=4.746 this round? Resident3 5.62, Resident6 5.62. So we can private_message to one of them. Choose Resident3. Message brief. Provide actions list with two items.
